newsitem.title: USA: Missouri unemployment falls to 3.8 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Missouri unemployment falls to 3.8 pct in May.

text.p: Missouri's unemployment rate fell from 4.2 percent in April to 3.8 percent in May, the Department of Labor and Industrial Relations reported.
The seasonally adjusted rate for May hit 4 percent, the lowest rate since 1978, the department said in a statement released Monday.
Nonfarm payroll employment saw the largest increase for the month inflated by the return of workers to an automobile plant who had been liad off temporarily.
Much of the increased employment came from seasonal work in construction, retail trade and services which also experienced some growth beyond the expected increases.
